import Mathlib
import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem product_projections_are_quotient_maps {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y]
  (π₁ : X × Y → X) (π₂ : X × Y → Y)
  (h₁ : π₁ = Prod.fst) (h₂ : π₂ = Prod.snd) :
  Topology.IsQuotientMap π₁ ∧ Topology.IsQuotientMap π₂ := by
  subst h₁ h₂
  constructor
  · exact isOpenMap_fst.isQuotientMap continuous_fst (fun x => ⟨(x, Classical.choice ‹Nonempty Y›), rfl⟩)
  · exact isOpenMap_snd.isQuotientMap continuous_snd (fun y => ⟨(Classical.choice ‹Nonempty X›, y), rfl⟩)

import Aesop
set_option maxHeartbeats 2000000
set_option autoImplicit false
open Filter Set TopologicalSpace
open scoped Topology

theorem product_projections_are_quotient_maps {X Y : Type*} [TopologicalSpace X] [TopologicalSpace Y] [Nonempty X] [Nonempty Y]
  (π₁ : X × Y → X) (π₂ : X × Y → Y)
  (h₁ : π₁ = Prod.fst) (h₂ : π₂ = Prod.snd) :
  Topology.IsQuotientMap π₁ ∧ Topology.IsQuotientMap π₂ := by
  subst h₁
  subst h₂
  constructor
  · first
      | exact IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap isOpenMap_fst continuous_fst (fun x => ⟨(x, Classical.choice ‹Nonempty Y›), rfl⟩)
      | exact IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap isOpenMap_fst (fun x => ⟨(x, Classical.choice ‹Nonempty Y›), rfl⟩) continuous_fst
      | exact isOpenMap_fst.isQuotientMap (fun x => ⟨(x, Classical.choice ‹Nonempty Y›), rfl⟩) continuous_fst
      | exact isOpenMap_fst.isQuotientMap continuous_fst (fun x => ⟨(x, Classical.choice ‹Nonempty Y›), rfl⟩)
      | (apply IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap; · exact isOpenMap_fst; · exact continuous_fst; · intro x; obtain ⟨y⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›; exact ⟨(x, y), rfl⟩)
      | (apply IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap; · exact isOpenMap_fst; · intro x; obtain ⟨y⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›; exact ⟨(x, y), rfl⟩; · exact continuous_fst)
      | (
          have hsurj : Function.Surjective (Prod.fst : X × Y → X) := fun x => ⟨(x, Classical.choice ‹Nonempty Y›), rfl⟩
          have hcont : Continuous (Prod.fst : X × Y → X) := continuous_fst
          have hquot : ∀ s : Set X, IsOpen (Prod.fst ⁻¹' s) → IsOpen s := by
            intro s hs
            obtain ⟨y0⟩ := ‹Nonempty Y›
            have hc : Continuous (fun x : X => (x, y0)) := continuous_id.prodMk continuous_const
            have heq : s = (fun x : X => (x, y0)) ⁻¹' (Prod.fst ⁻¹' s) := by ext x; simp
            rw [heq]
            exact hs.preimage hc
          first
            | exact ⟨hsurj, hcont, hquot⟩
            | exact ⟨hsurj, ⟨hcont, fun s => ⟨fun h => h.preimage hcont, fun h => hquot s h⟩⟩⟩
            | exact ⟨hsurj, ⟨hcont, hquot⟩⟩
        )
  · first
      | exact IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap isOpenMap_snd continuous_snd (fun y => ⟨(Classical.choice ‹Nonempty X›, y), rfl⟩)
      | exact IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap isOpenMap_snd (fun y => ⟨(Classical.choice ‹Nonempty X›, y), rfl⟩) continuous_snd
      | exact isOpenMap_snd.isQuotientMap (fun y => ⟨(Classical.choice ‹Nonempty X›, y), rfl⟩) continuous_snd
      | exact isOpenMap_snd.isQuotientMap continuous_snd (fun y => ⟨(Classical.choice ‹Nonempty X›, y), rfl⟩)
      | (apply IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap; · exact isOpenMap_snd; · exact continuous_snd; · intro y; obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›; exact ⟨(x, y), rfl⟩)
      | (apply IsOpenMap.isQuotientMap; · exact isOpenMap_snd; · intro y; obtain ⟨x⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›; exact ⟨(x, y), rfl⟩; · exact continuous_snd)
      | (
          have hsurj : Function.Surjective (Prod.snd : X × Y → Y) := fun y => ⟨(Classical.choice ‹Nonempty X›, y), rfl⟩
          have hcont : Continuous (Prod.snd : X × Y → Y) := continuous_snd
          have hquot : ∀ s : Set Y, IsOpen (Prod.snd ⁻¹' s) → IsOpen s := by
            intro s hs
            obtain ⟨x0⟩ := ‹Nonempty X›
            have hc : Continuous (fun y : Y => (x0, y)) := continuous_const.prodMk continuous_id
            have heq : s = (fun y : Y => (x0, y)) ⁻¹' (Prod.snd ⁻¹' s) := by ext y; simp
            rw [heq]

        )
